khos skra bskur bas rdul phra rab tu song*/ kho'i rtog pa la nang pa sangs rgyas pa la snying rje yod zer ba bden pa 'dug snyam pa dang*/ mar log nas mchod khang gi nang du zhugs/ ngo tsha nas lcebs par tshad pas glegs bam zhig gi glegs thag bkrol ba las/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud dang thug nas/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i mdo sde la ci 'dug lta snyam nas bltas pas ma khol lung bstan pa gzigs nas/ shin tu dad par gyur nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la zhugs/ mtshan slob dpon rta dbyangs su btags/ mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub thob/ bla ma la ma gus pa'i bshags pa la bla ma lnga bcu pa mdzad/ bka' la skur pa btab pa'i sdig bshags rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa mdzad/ dkon mchog gsum la ngan pa smras pa'i bshags pa la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa la sogs pa bstod pa brgya rtsa bcu pa brtsams/ sems can gyi srog la gnod pa byas pa'i bshags pa la/ sman dpyad yan lag brgya pa brtsams/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba bzhin du mdzad pa yang*/ chos skyong 'di yi bka' drin yin gsungs/ de la chos skyong gi sgrub thabs 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon 'phags pa la ye shes mgon pos phul/ des slob dpon ar+ya de ba la gsungs/ des mar me mdzad bzang po la/ des paṇ+ḍi ta dus 'khor ba chung ba la/ des a bha ya ka ra dang*/ tswa mi lo tsa la gsungs nas rgya gar du grags pa che/ bod du ni ma 'gyur ba la/ dus phyis mdo smad kyi khams su 'khrungs pa'i bla ma rga lo tsā ba chen po de/ brtson 'grus chen pos rgyud bskul nas/ yon tan rin po che'i don du rgya gar du byon nas/ bla ma rtsa mi la gdams ngag zhus/ abh+ya la dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gdams ngag zhus nas ko sa la kra ma'i gtsug lag khang gi nang du sgrub pa lo bdun mdzad/ grub pa thob nas ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyong ba'i don du/ dur khrod bsil ba tshal du byon nas chos skyong 'di zhal gzigs gtor ma byin/

shing glang ma'i me tog gi phreng ba zhig phul nas/ hūm̐/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba tshal// zhes pa'i bstod pa de der mdzad/ de nas chos skyong lus dang grib ma bzhin du phyir 'brangs nas/ bod du byon pa la chos rje phag mo gru pas zhus so// de ni nges shes bskyed pa'i lo rgyus so// ༈ //de la slob dpon 'phags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'di la/ dbu nas zhabs kyi bar du bsdus pa'i don gsum ni/ mchod par brjod pa dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba dang gnyis kyis slad kyi don dang*/ gang zag dang*/ gnas dang*/ ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa gsum gyis gzhung gi don dang*/ mjug gi don no// dang po la gsum ste/ yul dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la bstan bcos rtsom pa po chos drug dang ldan pa slob dpon 'phags pas mchod par brjod pa dang*/ tshul lam thabs ji ltar mchod cing brjod pa na// dpal ldan khrag 'thung zhes pa ste/ 'di la gsum/ dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don no// dang po ni/ dang po ni rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'o// gnyis pa la bcom ldan 'das 'khaur lo sdom pa'i dal bsdu ba'o// gsum pa ni dpal zhes pa/ rtogs pa bdag gi dpal dang*/ thugs rje gzhan gyi mgon te/ de dang ldan pas na dpal ldan no// khrag 'thung zhes pa ni/ 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho 'thung ba'o/ lha mo dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo la zhes pa ni/ lha mo ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa sum cu so bdun dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ma lus pa la btud ces pas mchod par brjod pa'o// nag po sgrub pa'i rim pa bri zhes pa ni/ bshad par dam bca' ba'o// des slad kyi don song nas/ gzhung gi don la gsum las/ dang po gang zag gi mtshan nyid dgu ste/ dbang dang*/ dam tshig bla ma la gus pa gal che ste med na mi 'grub pa'o// snying rje ni gong du bstan pa bzhin du gal che ste tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen po yin pa'i phyir ro// stong pa nyid bsgoms pa dang shes rab dang*/

bzod pa dang ldan pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa gal che'o// sgrub pa la dpa' ba ni/ lus dang srog la mi blta ba dang*/ bdag med pa rtogs pa dang*/ rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar nges pa dang gsum mo// rten gyi gang zag gi mtshan nyid 'di rnams gal che ste/ 'di dang ldan na chos skyong gi stong grogs byed pa chos nyid yin gsung/ mi ldan na sgrub pa byas kyang 'grub par dka' gsungs so// gnas kyi mtshan nyid la gnyis las/ las dang po pa yid 'ong ba'i gnas dang*/ drod thob na ri bo dur khrod ma mo la sogs pa'i 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas so// der bya ba'i rim pa spyi dang bye brag gnyis dug dang khrag la sogs pa rdzas gal che ste/ dug dang skye tshe yungs nag dang*// tsha ba gsum la gzugs brnyan bya// gdug pa can gyi me la sro// zhes pas/ drag po mngon spyod kyi 'phrin las bsgrub na/ de dang mthun pa'i rdzas kyi bsgrub pa don phu ba'i phyag dar bzhin no// gnas der kha lho phyogs su bltas la/ byang phyogs su zhal gzigs pa'i rten dgram/ de nas stan bde ba la bsdad de/ rang nyid lhag pa'i lha la mos nas/ sems bskyed pa ni/ bla ma la smod pa/ sems can la 'tshe ba thams cad kyi gtso byas pa'i gdug pa can thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya ba'i ched du sems bskyed la/ skad cig gis stong pa nyid du bsam ste/ de'i ngang las lhan skyes mngon rtogs lhar bskyed// de nas mdun du dur khrod lta bu'i gnas su mos la/ der paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma/ de'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag cig bsgom/ bdag gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ zhig bton te mdun gyi de la bstim/ des byin rlabs che ba dang phan yon dpag tu med/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa zhig bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas gdug pa can gyi gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/

lhag pa'i lhar gyur/ 'od zer tshur 'dus rdo rje la thim pas nag po chen po bya rog gi ming can zhes bya ba sku mdog mthing nag spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ hūm̐ hūm̐ dang phaṭa phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog pa/ dbu skra dang ag tshoms dang smin ma ser po gyen du 'bar ba phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang po na shing tog be ta'i 'bras bu mdog dmar ba dbyibs snying 'dra ba zhig snying gar bsnams pa/ g.yas gnyis pa na ral gri 'debs pa'i tshul du'o// g.yon dang po na thod khrag bsnams pa/ gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga cung zad 'phyar ba/ thod skam lngas skra chings byas pa/ thod rlon 'phreng bas do shal byas pa/ rin po che rtse 'phran la sogs pa dang*/ klu dkar po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ ser po dang*/ nag po rnams kyis sku la brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis dpa' bo 'dug stangs kyis sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ 'khor nag po stong gis bskor ba bsgom par bya'o// de'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dal gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag cig bsgom/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gnyis las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min gyi gnas nas bskyed pa lta bu zhig spyan drangs la/ dza ཿhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ brtan pa dang*/ dgyes par bskyed par bya'o// de nas sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ spyi bor zla ba'i dal gyi steng du oṃ/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥ snying gar nyi ma'i dal gyi steng du hūm̐ bsgoms te/ de yang phyi rol du ma bsgoms par spyi bor klad pa dung gi gzhal yas khang gi nang du dung lce'i steng dang*/ snying gi nang du bsgom mo// de yang oṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas sku'i rigs thams cad spyan drangs nas oṃ la thim pas rnam par snang mdzad du bsgoms pa dang*/

āḥlas 'od 'phros pas gsung gi rigs thams cad spyan drangs nas āḥl thim pas tshe dpag tu med par bsgoms pa dang*/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas thugs kyi rigs thams cad spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje sems dpar bsgom mo// 'di la dgos pa zhig yod pas bsnyen bsgrub kyi dus dang*/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i dus yang de bzhin du bya ste/ gzhung dang mi mthun par ngas slob dpon 'phags pa'i gzhung la log bshad pa byas pa min/ slob dpon de nyid kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa yin/ don gyi na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje 'chang nges pa'i shes pa gal che ste/ dgos pa ni sngags pa nang rgyas na ngag mnan pas mi thub pa dang mi non pa'o// chos skyong mthu dang nus pa shin tu che ba dang*/ bya rog 'ug pa bsad pa la sogs pa ltas ngan gang gis kyang mi tshugs so// gnad kyi man ngag gnyis pa'o// gzhan yang chos skyong la ma gus pa byar mi btub ste byas na de kho na bzhin du 'byung bas/ bla ma dang chos skyong rang gi sems yin/ sangs rgyas la sogs gang bltas bltas su 'ong ba yin/ bya rog gum pa dang mkha' 'gro ma smyo 'bog byed pa byung na mi rung bas/ de las zlog pa ni mos gus ltem rkyang med par sangs rgyas rnams dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong byin rlabs dang nus pa chung ba ni/ sgrub pa po chos dang mi ldan pa dam tshig nyams pas lan pa yin/ dgra snying hur thon byed 'dod na dam tshig tshul khrims la nan tan bya/ de med na chos skyong gis bsrung rgyu med/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs 'jug pa med/ des na rnal 'byor pa tshul bzhin du nyams su blangs pas chos skyong gi byin rlabs kyang 'byung ba yin/ gnyan mi gnyan yang rang gi sems yin te/ sngon phag mo gru pa'i chos skyong shin tu gnyan zhing tshub pa yin pa la/ ngas ni rje btsun spyan ras gzigs su bsgoms pas shin tu 'jam par byung ba yin/

don gyi chos skyong rang gi sems yin par bya ste/ gnad kyi man ngag gsum pa'o// de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rigs lnga dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas/ phyag dang mchod pas mchod de thugs ka nas rigs kyi yum bzhis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis bkang ba byung nas spyi bo nas mar dbang bskur bas mgon po'i las nyon shes bya'i sdig sgrib thams cad zhabs kyi sha dang sen mo'i bar nas mar nag nu ru ru byung nas/ chu zhabs kyi gyen la log pas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam mo// des ni chos skyong shin tu 'phrin las che ba yin gsung ste/ gnad kyi man ngag bzhi pa'o// de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul ba yin te/ sngon bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i spyan sngar gdug pa can thams cad bsgral bar dam bcas pa ste/ mdor na gdug pa can gyis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du thugs dam gyis shig par bskul ba ste/ de yang rang nyid kyi bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lhan cig skyes par gsal bar byas la/ de nas bdag dang nag po'i thugs kar hūm̐ gi mtha' ma yi ge bdun gyis bskor ba bsam ste/ de yang zhi ba ni sngags kyi phreng ba dkar ser bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas mdun gyi thugs kar thim pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te/ mi bsnyel zhing zhi ba'i las 'grub par bsam zhing*/ thugs ka'i sngags kyi nus pa dang 'dres nas zhal nas byung nas bdag gi zhal du zhugs nas thugs kar thim pas/ nad dang gnod pa sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar bsam/ bar gyi sngags kyi 'phreng ba la 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi nad dang gnod pa dang 'jig rten gyi 'tshe ba las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad zhi bar bsam/

rgyas pa la sngags kyi phreng ba ser po 'od zer ser po 'phros pas/ tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod rgyas par bsam mo// dbang la ni sngags kyi phreng ba dmar po 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas/ rgyal po dang bud med dang sems can thams cad dbang du 'dus shing bdag la 'dud par bsam/ mngon spyod la ni sngags kyi 'phreng ba nag po 'od zer nag po 'phros pas/ bstan pa la gnod pa sems can la 'tshe ba thams cad tshar bcad par bsam zhing bzlas par bya'o// 'phrin las bzhi sgrub na ni 'od zer kha dog rnam pa bzhi la sogs par bsam mo// skyo na gtor ma byin te dngos sam yid kyi mchod nas/ rkang pa brgyad pa la sogs pas bstod par bya'o// de nas 'phrin las bcol lo// thun 'jog pa'i dus su ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// de ltar bzlas pa rtags dang mtshan ma thon nas las la sbyor ba ni/ drag po thod nag gi bla ma'i gsung bzhin du nyams su blang bar bya'o// gsum pa mjug gi don ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya'o// grogs po gong mas bskul nas bla ma yi// gsung sgros zhal gyi gdams pa bdud rtsi 'di// lhag bsam dag pas yi ger bkod pa las// byung ba'i dge ba des ni 'gro ba rnams// bar chad gdug pa'i tshogs rnams rab bsal nas// ring por mi thogs sangs rgyas thob par shog// / ā+oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba da ta/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswa hā//
